events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Tupac Shakur was shot in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, and died six days later on September 13, 1996, at the age of 25.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years since his passing, Tupac Shakur's influence on music and culture remains as powerful as ever. What's your favourite track from the legend?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix, widely regarded as one of the greatest guitarists of all time, died on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix. His groundbreaking guitar work changed music forever. Which track showcases his talent best for you?

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album 'Abbey Road' was released on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles walked across that zebra crossing. 'Abbey Road' remains a masterpiece. What's your standout track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951, and turns 75 today.

angles.name: Rock Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and fierce attitude have made The Pretenders rock legends. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic frontman of Oasis and a successful solo artist, was born on September 21, 1972, and turns 54 today.

angles.name: Mad for it!
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! From Oasis anthems to his solo bangers, his voice is unmistakable. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: Imagine's Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic song 'Imagine' was released on October 11, 1971, in the US, and October 24, 1971, in the UK, as part of his album of the same name.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Over five decades since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how people listened to music.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? Twenty-five years ago, it changed everything. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the premiere of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's Global James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, 007 is pure cinematic gold. Who's your favourite Bond and why?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles and a legendary solo artist, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: John Cleese, the acclaimed English actor, comedian, and screenwriter known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on October 27, 1939, and turns 87 today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is unmatched. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: The White Album Turns
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling 'White Album'. A diverse collection that pushed boundaries. What are your hidden gems on this iconic record?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, died on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: A True Showman
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's the Queen song that always gets you?

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: A New Direction
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' marked a pivotal shift in their sound. Which track from this influential album is your favourite?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: John Lennon, a founding member of The Beatles and an iconic solo artist, was tragically shot and killed on December 8, 1980, in New York City.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Message
angles.copy: Forty-six years since the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. What's the song you turn to for comfort or inspiration?
